value.rationale: Deleting one matching from the standard complete-bipartite excitation network changes the exact recurrent spectrum, creating an unusual primitive period 30 at one natural and precisely characterized graph size. The exceptional 2688-orbit invariant, exclusion at every other size, exact universal 9-step transient bound and explicit microscopic certificate are structural results for an infinite graph family; this is not a numerical exercise on arbitrarily chosen parameters.
